title: Hyesan Youth Copper Mine workers’ passive resistance during a mandatory criticism session
reason: Daily NK reports roughly 10 mine workers in an internal workplace session, below the 50-person threshold and not a public gathering. The grievance concerned workplace enforcement of mandatory sessions and paid absences; no qualifying public demand on state policy is established.
notes: Article was published Nov 5 but describes the incident on Oct 26. The event is October-owned. Body was opened during November research; exact body/receipt live in the cross-referenced November unit. The source is not independent of NK24NOV-S002.
